source.citation: Yoshizane C, Mizote A, Yamada M, Arai N, Arai S, Maruta K, Mitsuzumi H, Ariyasu T. Glycemic, insulinemic and incretin responses after oral trehalose ingestion in healthy subjects. Nutr J 2017;16:9.

original_assets_kept_outside_public_repl.note: Not needed for the default --check. Audit with: python -I -X utf8 trehalose.py --check --sources DIRECTORY

Fig1.png.origin: Springer media CDN rendering of Fig. 1 (served as PNG)

design.type: crossover, two occasions at least 1 week apart, overnight fast

exclusions.reason: borborygmus and osmotic diarrhoea after trehalose (onset 50 and 90 min), withdrawn
suspected insulin resistance from high fasting insulin

design.excluded_outcomes: not reported; their effect on either ratio has unknown direction
design.analysed_demographics: 10 women, 10 men; age 39.0 +/- 1.6 y; BMI 20.8 +/- 0.3 kg/m2; healthy Japanese
design.locator: Methods (Subjects, Study design); Results (Analytical subjects of this study)

products.stated_dose: 25 g trehalose (i.e., 28 g of TREHA) or 25 g glucose, in 100 mL water, within 2 min
products.rounding_note: 28 g is printed to whole grams; the non-dihydrate remainder of TREHA (up to 2%) is unspecified

sampling_and_assay.assay: chemiluminescent enzyme immunoassay, SRL Inc. (Nara, Japan)

operator.text: incremental area under the response curve (IAUC), ignoring the area beneath the fasting concentration
operator.statistic: mean +/- SE, n = 20; paired Student t-test on IAUC (p < 0.01)

discussion_insulin_individual_ratio.locator: Discussion: 'the mean individual blood insulin IAUC ratio of trehalose loading to glucose loading was 36%'
discussion_insulin_individual_ratio.context_not_scored: the same paragraph gives a mean individual glucose IAUC ratio of 38% and GIP 14%

figure1_insulin_visual_reading.status: APPROXIMATE visual reading of plotted group means by this implementer (about +/-0.5 uIU/mL); descriptive check only
figure1_insulin_visual_reading.locator: Fig. 1 right panel (serum insulin, mean +/- SE, n = 20)

frozen_comparators.provenance_note: Holub: isomaltulose/sucrose; Johansen: oligomalt/maltodextrin. Rival transport hypotheses from distinct substrates.

external_level_anchor.status: cross-cohort challenge only; not a frozen comparator
external_level_anchor.source: Lee BM, MSc thesis, University of Toronto 1997, Table 3-1 (printed p. 34); values visually confirmed by the coordinator and Sol
external_level_anchor.operator: mean participant-positive incremental plasma insulin area 0-120 min
external_level_anchor.differences: plasma vs serum; different assay, laboratory and cohort (Toronto vs lean Japanese adults); same 0-120 positive-area operator family

unit_conversion_conventions.status: CONDITIONAL; neither source states a conversion between uIU/mL and pmol/L
